snippet.title: Critical Integrity - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming soon to Steam. Join the Discord to get pinged when wishlists open: https://discord.gg/3JbzmuaXkX

Critical Integrity is a holy-trinity, tab-targeting ARPG rogue-lite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players, with raid-style bosses and powerful loot. Tank, Heal, or DPS. Play solo or with friends; missing a role? You’ll gain new spells and buffs to cover it.

You’ve been summoned by the omnipotent System to cleanse the corruption spreading through a crumbling multiverse. Battle through dungeons drawn from every corner of that multiverse, growing your strength through loot and permanent class rank-ups. Defeat monsters to level up and choose new abilities as you delve into ever-higher corruption.

Should you perish, fear not: the System pulls you back to Haven, your bastion of safety, where merchants and crafters help you prepare for the next dive. Your gear, class ranks and corruption unlocks carry over every run, so you always come back stronger.

Rescue the citizens of the multiverse and aid the System!
